nodes.label: LUCA Health OS
nodes.rationale: Enterprise-grade Health Operating System (B2B2C) connecting Patients, Doctors, Pharmacies, and Clinics. Built on Next.js App Router with TypeScript strict mode.

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Business logic grouped by domain under src/features/ (auth, consultations, marketplace). Each feature has its own components/, hooks/, schemas/, types/ subdirectories. Prevents dumping all components into src/components.

nodes.label: Clean & Elevated Design Language
nodes.rationale: Design language must inspire trust, hygiene, and premium technology. Prohibits neo-brutalism. Primary color is Teal, uses Plus Jakarta Sans typography, bg-slate-50 for app backgrounds.

nodes.label: Notion-Isomatic Design System
nodes.rationale: LUCA design system inspired by Notion's minimal aesthetic. Zero shadows (shadow-none), pharmako-* token namespace for all colors, borders and semantic states. Separates Doctor/Patient (blue primary) and Pharmacy/Medications (teal care) palettes.

nodes.label: Pharmako Design Token System
nodes.rationale: All surfaces, text, borders and semantic states must use pharmako-* prefixed tokens (e.g. bg-pharmako-surface, text-pharmako-text-primary). Raw Tailwind tokens like text-slate-* or bg-teal-* are prohibited in feature code.

nodes.label: LUCA Earth/Green Fluid UI Palette
nodes.rationale: Earth-toned palette with luca-primary (#163422 dark green), luca-accent (#D97B51 terracotta orange), luca-surface (#f5f3ee warm beige). Semantic tokens declared in globals.css @theme inline block for Tailwind v4 auto-generation.

nodes.label: Server Components First Pattern
nodes.rationale: All Next.js pages and layouts must be Server Components. Only add 'use client' at the lowest possible leaf node (interactive buttons, forms). Do NOT use useEffect for data fetching; use TanStack Query hooks instead.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Data Fetching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Data fetching via TanStack Query (React Query) + Axios. Custom hooks must live in the respective feature folder. Prohibits useEffect for data fetching.

nodes.label: Role-Based Dashboard Routing
nodes.rationale: Single /dashboard route routes to PatientDashboard, DoctorDashboard, or PharmacyDashboard based on user role (patient | doctor | pharmacy).

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Workflow
nodes.rationale: All non-trivial features use SDD with artifact sequence: init.md, explore.md, proposal.md, spec.md, design.md, tasks.md. Stored under openspec/changes/YYYY-MM-DD_name/.

nodes.label: Offline-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single POST /api/sync endpoint handles bulk push+pull. Client generates UUIDs offline. Upsert with Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution based on updated_at timestamp. Soft deletes supported. Max 500 records per pull with has_more pagination.

nodes.label: DB Table: PatientAccount
nodes.rationale: Global patient identity across LUCA ecosystem. Phone (WhatsApp) is primary identifier, globally unique. One PatientAccount can link to multiple Patient records (one per doctor).

nodes.label: DB Table: User
nodes.rationale: Professional users (DOCTOR, PROVIDER, ADMIN). Controls authentication, plan tier (FREE/PRO/ENTERPRISE), professional branding (logoUrl, signatureUrl).

nodes.label: DB Table: Patient
nodes.rationale: Doctor's CRM medical record for a patient. Owned by userId (doctor). privateNotes never visible to patient via portal. Links to global PatientAccount optionally.

nodes.label: DB Table: Consultation
nodes.rationale: Core clinical encounter following SOAP note structure (Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan). dynamicData JSONB stores form template responses. Status: pending→in-progress→completed→cancelled.

nodes.label: DB Table: Prescription
nodes.rationale: Live prescription with publicToken for pharmacy verification via QR. Status: ACTIVE→CANCELLED|EXPIRED. Links to consultation 1:1 optionally.

nodes.label: DB Table: Medication (Vademécum)
nodes.rationale: Global (userId=NULL) and personal (userId=NOT NULL) medication catalog. Fields: activePrinciple, concentration, presentation, administrationRoute.

nodes.label: DB Table: ProviderProfile
nodes.rationale: 1:1 with User (role=PROVIDER). Represents pharmacy or laboratory in the marketplace. isOpen and isVerified control marketplace participation.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicBranch
nodes.rationale: Physical location of a clinic. All clinical acts (consultations, prescriptions, invoices) are bound to ClinicBranch (not Clinic) for precise geolocation. Stores lat/lon with DECIMAL(10,8) for accuracy.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicBranchMember
nodes.rationale: Links doctor to specific clinic branch with department and officeNumber. Allows a doctor to rotate between multiple branches.

nodes.label: DB Table: FormTemplate
nodes.rationale: Dynamic form builder. userId=NULL means global LUCA template; userId=NOT NULL is doctor's personal template. schemaJson JSONB stores input definitions array.

nodes.label: DB Table: AuditLog (HIPAA)
nodes.rationale: HIPAA compliance. Immutable log of all accesses/changes. Every GET on clinical records must fire a VIEW AuditLog entry. ON DELETE SET NULL on userId so logs persist even if user deleted.

nodes.label: DB Table: PharmacyInventory
nodes.rationale: Optimistic concurrency via version INT column to prevent race conditions on stock. DECIMAL(10,2) for unitPrice (never FLOAT for money).

nodes.label: DB Table: DoctorSchedule
nodes.rationale: Recurring weekly schedule per doctor. Unique per (userId, weekday). Controls appointmentDuration and maxPerSlot.

nodes.label: DB Table: ScheduleException
nodes.rationale: Overrides for VACATION, DAY_OFF, CUSTOM_HOURS. Exceptions are evaluated first in availability validation before schedule base.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicSchedule
nodes.rationale: Clinic branch operating hours. Doctor schedules can be more restrictive but never wider than clinic schedule.

nodes.label: DB Table: FollowUp
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp-based patient follow-up reminder linked to Consultation. Status: PENDING→SENT→RESPONDED.

nodes.label: Marketplace B2B2C
nodes.rationale: Connects patients/doctors with pharmacies and laboratories for prescription quote requests. Flow: Doctor creates Rx with publicToken → Patient requests quotes → Pharmacies respond with QuoteOffers → Patient picks best price.

nodes.label: Hybrid Relational + JSONB Schema Pattern
nodes.rationale: Avoids Sparse Tables and EAV anti-pattern. Fixed relational columns for common fields; JSONB indexed columns (dynamicData in Consultation, schemaJson in FormTemplate) for specialty-specific clinical data.

nodes.label: Organisation-Sede (Clinic/Branch) Model
nodes.rationale: Separates Clinic (legal entity/brand) from ClinicBranch (physical location). All clinical acts bound to clinicBranchId for precise geolocation and doctor rotation across branches.

nodes.label: Geographic Normalization (Country/State/City)
nodes.rationale: Three-level geo hierarchy. Entities only store cityId (not stateId or countryId). City deduces its parent hierarchy. Enables precise marketplace geo-filtering.

nodes.label: UUID Native Type vs VARCHAR Decision
nodes.rationale: database.md uses VARCHAR for UUID PKs (37+ bytes), wastes space and slows JOINs. Plan: migrate to native PostgreSQL UUID type (16 bytes binary). UUIDs generated by client offline for sync, mapped to server's internal sequential IDs via hybrid approach.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS) Multi-tenancy
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL RLS policies enforce clinic/doctor data isolation at DB level. Backend sets app.current_user_id session variable per transaction. Prevents API bugs from exposing cross-tenant patient data.

nodes.label: Public Catalog API (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated endpoints: GET /public/doctors, GET /public/pharmacies, GET /public/clinics, GET /public/doctors/{id}/availability. Only verified entities (is_verified=true) appear. Supports geo-filter by city_id and specialty_id.

nodes.label: Doctor Scheduling System (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Availability validation order: 1) ScheduleException check, 2) DoctorSchedule weekday check, 3) Time range check, 4) maxPerSlot capacity check. Clinic schedule acts as upper bound for doctor schedule.

nodes.label: Offline Sync Conflict Resolution (LWW)
nodes.rationale: Last-Write-Wins based on updated_at timestamps. For appointments, additionally validates slot availability via AvailabilityService. Selective failure: individual record errors don't abort the whole transaction.

nodes.label: Responsive Design Rules (Mobile-First)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first with Tailwind breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl). Prohibits fixed widths like w-[800px]. Tables must be wrapped in overflow-x-auto. Touch targets must be minimum 44x44px on mobile. No modification of business logic (useState, hooks, API calls).

nodes.label: SOAP Note Clinical Documentation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Standard clinical documentation: Subjective (reason/chief complaint), Objective (physicalExam + vitals), Assessment (diagnosis), Plan (treatmentPlan). dynamicData captures specialty-specific form responses.

nodes.label: Prescription Public Token (QR Verification)
nodes.rationale: Unique shareable token on Prescription and MedicalDocument. Embedded in QR code so pharmacies or employers can verify authenticity without LUCA login. Must use cryptographically secure nano ID (min 10 chars).

nodes.label: HIPAA/GDPR Compliance Strategy
nodes.rationale: AuditLog is immutable (no DELETE endpoint). Every GET on clinical data must fire VIEW log entry. Combined with RLS for defense-in-depth. KYC via VerificationDocument module.

nodes.label: DB Table: ProviderBranch
nodes.rationale: Physical branch of pharmacy/lab. isOpen is per-branch so main branch can be 24h while shopping-mall branch is closed.

nodes.label: Zustand Auth Store (useAuthStore)
nodes.rationale: Manages global client state: role, name, token. Located at src/store/auth.ts.

nodes.label: Framer Motion Animation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Framer Motion used exclusively for layout transitions, smart component mounting, complex dialogs. easeOut physics required, never linear. Tailwind animate-in used for micro-interactions.

nodes.label: Medications Page Implementation Summary
nodes.author: Antigravity
nodes.rationale: Documents the routing fix (navigation from /medications to /dashboard/medications so the sidebar stays), DB v3 field integration (requiresPrescription, contraindications), and a full UI premium polish pass aligning with the doctor dashboard design system tokens.

nodes.label: API Authentication Documentation (Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: HTTP-Only cookie (auth_token) chosen over localStorage for security. Hybrid UUID→BIGINT geolocation resolution allows fast DB joins while exposing safe identifiers externally. Clinics excluded from public self-registration (B2B onboarding only) to enforce institutional trust model.

nodes.label: API Phase 2 Documentation — Clinical Records
nodes.rationale: Idempotency-Key required on all POST operations to handle unstable connections safely. Upsert semantics used on VitalSigns and LabRequests (singular resource per consultation) to avoid duplicate records.

nodes.label: API Phase 3 Documentation — Vademecum, Prescriptions & Marketplace
nodes.rationale: public_token (16-char unique token) generated automatically on prescription and medical document creation to enable QR-based verification without exposing internal IDs. Marketplace follows patient→quote-request→pharmacy-offer flow, decoupling pricing from clinical data.

nodes.label: API Phase 4 Documentation — Operations, Billing & HIPAA Audit
nodes.rationale: Audit logs are immutable (no create/update/delete endpoints) to comply with HIPAA. Invoice items and payments have no PUT/PATCH — delete and re-create to ensure auditability. Automatic invoice status transitions (PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID) triggered server-side on payment recording.

nodes.label: API Phase 5 Spec — Patient Portal Self-Service Access
nodes.rationale: Direct patient_account_id FK added to consultations, invoices, medical_documents to avoid costly multi-hop joins from PatientAccount→Patient→clinical data. PatientAccount hasOne→hasMany Patient changed because a patient can be registered by multiple doctors. Public QR verification endpoints are unauthenticated to enable pharmacy/employer verification without forcing account creation.

nodes.label: Frontend Implementation Guide of Backend (comprehensive)
nodes.rationale: Polling recommended (no WebSocket) at 30s for notifications and 60s for marketplace offers. Retry with same Idempotency-Key UUID on network failure — do NOT generate new UUID per retry. File uploads go to external storage (S3/Cloudinary) then only URL sent to API — the API has no binary upload endpoint.

nodes.label: Frontend Implementation Guide — Auth & TypeScript Types (Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: specialty_ids must be appended with bracket notation (specialty_ids[0], specialty_ids[1]) in multipart/form-data for Laravel to parse as array. Branch model (ClinicBranch, ProviderBranch) introduced to support multi-location clinics and pharmacies — address and phone moved off the main entity.

nodes.label: Offline Sync API Spec — Push & Pull (Backend)
nodes.rationale: Single bulk endpoint (POST /api/sync) chosen over individual REST calls to minimize round-trips on unstable connections. Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict resolution chosen for simplicity. Topological insertion order required server-side to respect FK constraints without aborting entire sync on partial failures.

nodes.label: Offline-First Frontend Integration Guide
nodes.rationale: Binary files (photos, PDFs) sent separately via POST /api/documents/upload after sync JSON completes — metadata first then binary — to keep the sync payload small and allow partial success. IndexedDB used as local persistence layer so offline data survives session loss.

nodes.label: API Phase 6 — Public Catalog (Doctors, Pharmacies, Clinics)
nodes.rationale: Only verified entities (is_verified=true) exposed publicly to maintain trust. No authentication required to allow anonymous patient discovery of doctors and pharmacies.

nodes.label: Auth Tabs Redesign — Technical Design
nodes.rationale: colors.ts deleted in favor of CSS variables (globals.css @theme inline block) to enable Tailwind utility class usage and eliminate runtime JS color tokens. All inline style={{ }} replaced with conditional className to support Tailwind's JIT purging.

nodes.label: Auth Tabs Redesign — Proposal
nodes.rationale: pharmako-login component library chosen as the canonical isomatic style target. AuthContainer wraps both Login and Register under a single tab bar to eliminate the disconnected auth flows.

nodes.label: Dashboard Structure Redesign — Proposal
nodes.rationale: Morning Briefing layout chosen over Patient Flow and Contextual layouts because Próximo Paciente card is the most actionable item a doctor can have. Data dashboard replaced with work dashboard — focus on answering 'what to do next' rather than displaying raw metrics.

nodes.label: macOS-Style Sidebar — Technical Design
nodes.rationale: CSS transition-all + Framer Motion layout animations chosen over pure CSS width transition to enable child stagger animations while keeping dependency overhead minimal. Frosted glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl) chosen for premium macOS floating aesthetic.

nodes.label: Pharmako Design System
nodes.rationale: pharmako-login component library established as the single source of truth for auth surface design tokens (#0057FF primary, #23DCE1 care, rounded-xl, PharmakoInput primitives) to enforce visual consistency across login/register flows.

nodes.label: Idempotency Key Pattern
nodes.rationale: UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key required on all POST operations. Same UUID must be reused on network retry (do NOT regenerate). 24-hour server-side cache. Chosen to prevent duplicate record creation on unstable connections common in medical environments.

nodes.label: Offline-First Sync Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single bulk POST /api/sync endpoint with Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution. UUID generated client-side for all records. Topological entity ordering in push payload required to respect FK constraints. Up to 500 records per pull with has_more pagination for first sync.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication Model
nodes.rationale: HTTP-Only secure cookie (auth_token) used for session management — frontend never touches token in localStorage. Separate auth guards: auth:user_api for doctors/providers/staff and auth:patient_api for patient accounts.

nodes.label: Marketplace B2B2C Flow
nodes.rationale: Patients request quotes from pharmacies via QuoteRequest; pharmacies respond with QuoteOffers. Patient compares prices and chooses a pharmacy. Actual fulfillment happens out-of-band (WhatsApp, phone) — the API only manages the quotation lifecycle.

nodes.label: HIPAA Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Audit logs are immutable — no create/update/delete endpoints exist. Every GET to clinical resources (Consultations, Prescriptions, MedicalDocuments, LabResults) auto-triggers a VIEW audit log entry. Only ADMIN role can read logs.

nodes.label: Prescription QR Public Token
nodes.rationale: 16-character public_token auto-generated on prescription and medical document creation. Embedded in QR code on printed prescription. Enables pharmacies and employers to verify authenticity without requiring a LUCA account, via public GET /verify endpoints.

nodes.label: Patient Portal (Phase 5)
nodes.rationale: Direct patient_account_id FK added to key clinical tables to avoid expensive PatientAccount→Patient→data joins. PatientAccount changed from hasOne to hasMany Patient since a patient can be registered by multiple doctors.

nodes.label: Workflow-Centered Doctor Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Data dashboard replaced with work dashboard paradigm. Three-tab structure (Resumen/Flujo/Seguimiento) with Morning Briefing as default. Every element answers: what needs attention NOW, what is happening today, where to go next.

nodes.label: macOS-Style Floating Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Frosted glass floating sidebar (detached from edges, rounded-2xl, backdrop-blur-xl) chosen to give premium macOS feel. Icons-first collapsed state with hover-to-expand behavior reduces visual clutter while keeping navigation always accessible.

nodes.label: KYC Verification Process
nodes.rationale: Doctors and providers submit license/RIF documents during registration. KYC pending blocks clinical access (HTTP 403). Admin approves/rejects via PUT /verification-documents. Ensures only verified professionals operate on the platform.

nodes.label: Multi-Sede Branch Architecture
nodes.rationale: Address and phone moved off Clinic/Provider entities into ClinicBranch/ProviderBranch sub-entities. Every clinic/provider has at least one branch (is_main_branch=true). Supports multi-location healthcare networks.

nodes.label: Public Catalog API (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated endpoints for discovering verified doctors, pharmacies, and clinics. Only is_verified=true entities returned. Geolocation fields (latitude, longitude, google_maps_url) on branches enable map integrations.

nodes.label: macOS Sidebar Proposal
nodes.rationale: Current sidebar is visually heavy and does not match the Clean & Elevated design language; a macOS/FindMy-style floating sidebar with frosted glass and icon-only collapsed state is proposed.

nodes.label: macOS-Style Floating Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Detached floating sidebar with frosted glass (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl), collapsed icon-only rail (~72px), expanded with text labels (~220px), hover-to-expand and click-to-toggle, localStorage persistence, and smooth framer-motion animation.

nodes.label: Sidebar inDrawer Mobile Prop
nodes.rationale: Mobile rendering uses full-width drawer with no collapse toggle or hover; controlled by the inDrawer prop to keep the floating behaviour separate from mobile UX.

nodes.label: Adaptive Scrollbar Theme Init
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded oklch scrollbar colors do not adapt to dark mode; solution is to move thumb colors into CSS custom properties under :root and .dark for webkit and Firefox.

nodes.label: SearchCommand Duplicate Fix Init
nodes.rationale: Duplicate SearchCommand components in Sidebar caused two overlapping search dialogs; fix removes all SearchCommand references from Sidebar, deferring CMD+K handling to SmartHeader.

nodes.label: SearchCommand Deduplication
nodes.rationale: CMD+K handled globally by SearchCommand in SmartHeader; Sidebar must not register its own SearchCommand or keyboard shortcut effect.

nodes.label: Patient Dashboard Init
nodes.rationale: Patient dashboard is a minimal fallback; goal is to build a full feature under src/features/patient-dashboard/ following doctor/pharmacy patterns.

nodes.label: Patient Dashboard Feature
nodes.rationale: Complete patient-role dashboard under src/features/patient-dashboard/ with greeting, KPIs, next appointment, quick actions, active treatment, vital signs, and consultation history; follows doctor/pharmacy dashboard pattern with Notion-isomatic styling, zero shadows, lucide icons, and mock data hooks ready for TanStack Query.

nodes.label: Notion-Isomatic Design System
nodes.rationale: Design constraint enforced across all dashboards: bg-slate-50 app background, bg-white cards, border-slate-100/200 borders, rounded-xl/2xl, teal primary, emerald success, amber warning, zero box-shadows, generous spacing (p-6/p-8).

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each role dashboard is a self-contained feature folder: types/index.ts, hooks/, components/, index.ts barrel export. Components must not live in src/app/dashboard/ directly.

nodes.label: Mock Data Hooks Pattern
nodes.rationale: Hooks returning static arrays as mock data, structured identically to future TanStack Query hooks; called in the composition root and distributed as props to keep child components pure and testable.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Readiness
nodes.rationale: Mock data hooks are shaped to mirror eventual TanStack Query hooks so the migration from static mock to real API requires only replacing hook internals with no component changes.

nodes.label: Clinic Dashboard Init
nodes.rationale: Clinic role currently shows a no-dashboard fallback; build src/features/clinic-dashboard/ from scratch following patient/doctor/pharmacy pattern.

nodes.label: Clinic Dashboard Feature
nodes.rationale: Dashboard for clinic role surfacing daily operations: KPIs (consultas hoy, doctores activos, pacientes atendidos, recetas emitidas), TodayAgenda of consultations, DoctorsList on duty, and quick actions. Uses blue-700 primary instead of teal to distinguish the clinic role.

nodes.label: Role-Based Dashboard Routing
nodes.rationale: DashboardPage switches on user role (patient, doctor, clinic, pharmacy) and renders the corresponding feature dashboard component. Each role maps to one barrel-exported composition root.

nodes.label: Consultations Module Init
nodes.rationale: Existing consultations feature has 7 shadows, 74 luca-* token references, components not wired into a flow, and no routes; full redesign + expansion needed.

nodes.label: Consultations Module
nodes.rationale: Three-phase redesign of src/features/consultations/: remove shadows and luca-* tokens, add a list page (/dashboard/consultations), and add a detail page (/dashboard/consultations/[id]) with PatientContextCard, ConsultationTabs (SOAP), and DigitalPrescriptionCard.

nodes.label: luca-* Token to pharmako-care Migration
nodes.rationale: 74 luca-* CSS token references across consultations components must be replaced with pharmako-care / blue-700 / slate-* tokens to align with the unified design system.

nodes.label: Doctor Dashboard Token Migration
nodes.rationale: Replace luca-primary / luca-accent / luca-muted / luca-surface / luca-surface-dark tokens with pharmako-care / emerald / slate-500 / white / slate-100, and remove all shadows (shadow-sm/md/xl) from doctor dashboard components.

nodes.label: Zero Shadow Design Constraint
nodes.rationale: Explicit user requirement: no shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-2xl, or drop-shadow anywhere in dashboard components. Verification via grep is required in acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: pharmako-care Design Token
nodes.rationale: Custom CSS token used for icon and accent colors across clinic, doctor, and consultations features; paired with bg-pharmako-care-light wrappers. Replaces luca-primary token.

nodes.label: Framer Motion Stagger Animations
nodes.rationale: fadeUpVariant and staggerChildrenVariant from @/app/lib/animations used for section entry and list animations across all dashboard features.

nodes.label: Notion-Isomatic Style
nodes.rationale: Aligns the doctor dashboard styling with the rest of the application by standardizing borders, backgrounds, removing shadows, and using consistent design tokens.

nodes.label: TrendDirection Refactor
nodes.rationale: Refactor TrendDirection model from 'lower-is-better'/'higher-is-better' to 'up'/'down'/'stable' to align with the patient-dashboard pattern.

nodes.label: Redundant Greeting Removal
nodes.rationale: Remove 'Buen día, doctor' greeting from FollowUpView because the greeting is now handled at the parent level by the new DoctorGreeting component.

nodes.label: Pharmako Person Two PC and Phone Scene
Pharmako Person Reviewing Documents Extra Large (WEBP)

LUCA Design System: Notion-Isomatic + Pharmako Tokens + Feature Architecture
Auth Ecosystem — JWT + Cookie + KYC
hyperedges.description: JWT auth model, KYC verification process, and the auth documentation collectively define the full authentication lifecycle for doctors, providers, and patients in LUCA.

hyperedges.label: Prescription → QR → Marketplace Flow
hyperedges.description: The prescription QR token, B2B2C marketplace, and patient portal form a unified cross-actor flow: doctor creates prescription with QR token, patient requests quotes, pharmacies respond with offers.

hyperedges.label: SDD Auth Redesign Artifacts
hyperedges.description: The proposal, design, and task breakdown for the auth tabs + isomatic redesign form a complete SDD change artifact triad for the pharmako-login unification.

hyperedges.label: Unified Design System Constraints
hyperedges.rationale: All three concepts co-apply across every dashboard feature (patient, clinic, doctor, consultations): Notion-isomatic aesthetic, zero shadows, and pharmako-care as the primary icon/accent token.

hyperedges.label: Dashboard Feature Implementation Pattern
hyperedges.rationale: Every role dashboard (patient, clinic, doctor, pharmacy) is built using the same three-concept pattern: feature folder with types/hooks/components, mock data hooks as the data layer, and role-based routing wired from DashboardPage.

hyperedges.label: luca-to-pharmako Token Migration Wave
hyperedges.rationale: Both the consultations module and the doctor dashboard redesign perform the same class of work: bulk-replacing luca-* CSS tokens with pharmako-care and slate-* tokens, converging on the same design token.

hyperedges.label: Zero Shadow Aesthetic Applied Across Features
